deposit.name: Round Top
deposit.notes: Low-grade, HREE-rich, acid-soluble fluorite; 90-95% inert quartz+feldspar.

methods.name: Dilute H2SO4 heap leach
methods.fit_to_host: high — yttrofluorite dissolves in dilute sulfuric at ambient T
methods.recovery: cited column/bucket: Y 61%, Dy 57.5% on 1/2–in crush (US 9,890,441); many tests 42–49% Y+HREE
methods.reagents: H2SO4 5–100 g/L tested; patent example ~8.3% v/v or 10 g/L bucket tests
methods.waste: acidic raffinate, residual F, U/Th reporting; gypsum if lime neutralize
methods.scale: the designed path for this mountain; heap is how you treat a billion-ton low-grade rhyolite
methods.cost: order-of-magnitude: heap opex dominated by acid + neutralize; unknown without current PEA

methods.name: Dilute HCl leach
methods.fit_to_host: medium-high — patent allows HCl; chloride liquor feeds classic SX
methods.recovery: less Round Top column data than sulfate
methods.reagents: HCl; more expensive than H2SO4, easier SX
methods.scale: tank or heap; chloride heap is messier than sulfate
methods.cost: likely higher reagent than sulfate heap
methods.verdict: use if SX train wants chloride.

methods.name: Solvent extraction PC88A (EHEHPA)
methods.fit_to_host: after leach; fights Y (adjacent, abundant at Round Top)
methods.recovery: cited on Y-concentrate (not Round Top PLS): ~93% Dy at ~97% Dy2O3 (Thakur 2000)
methods.reagents: PC88A in kerosene; acid for strip; saponification common
methods.energy: mixer-settler pumping; many stages for Dy/Y
methods.cost: capex in stages + inventory; opex extractant + acid
methods.verdict: workhorse Dy/Y split. Must be sized for Round Top Y:Dy.

methods.name: Solvent extraction D2EHPA
methods.fit_to_host: stronger extractant than PC88A; less selective among HREE
methods.recovery: high extraction, harder strip; used in classic REE fractionation
methods.reagents: D2EHPA + kerosene; stronger acid to strip Dy
methods.cost: similar SX; more stages or harsher strip
methods.verdict: good for bulk HREE load; PC88A often cleaner for Dy polish.

methods.name: Solvent extraction Cyanex 272 / 572
methods.fit_to_host: weaker than PC88A; Batchu 2020: PC88A extracts Dy better; Cyanex 572 better mid/HREE vs Dy selectivity in some cuts
methods.verdict: candidate for a Dy/Tb or Dy/Y polish step, not the leach.

methods.name: Extraction chromatography / LN resin
methods.fit_to_host: lab-to-pilot polish of Dy after bulk SX or from dilute PLS
methods.recovery: high purity possible; capacity low vs SX
methods.reagents: impregnated organophosphorus resin; mineral acid eluent
methods.scale: poor as sole plant for mountain-scale PLS; good for oxide polish
methods.cost: resin $ high per kg Dy if used as primary split

methods.name: Oxalate precipitation
methods.fit_to_host: after separation; not selective among REE
methods.recovery: high if PLS is already Dy-rich
methods.verdict: how you make Dy2O3 after you already won the split.

methods.name: USAR Wheat Ridge flowsheet (opaque)
methods.fit_to_host: they produced 99.1% Dy2O3 from Round Top ore (Jan 2025, third-party ISO 17025)
methods.recovery: not published as a plant figure
methods.scale: demo / R&D; magnet plant is Stillwater OK, mine is Texas
methods.verdict: existence proof that Round Top ore can yield magnet-grade Dy oxide. Not a public recipe.
